dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and consistent geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth with a slight asymmetrical outward bulge on the upper left edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform mid-tone slate grey baseline; notably darker than mature white phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between subtle pigment variations across the dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Scattered small white high-contrast specularities; presence of a dark, vertically oriented linear mark near the anterior center.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Significant shadow-casting longitudinal groove positioned along the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep central longitudinal cleft and faint, thin diagonal linear striations visible on the upper left quadrant.
